## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.4.4

### Fixed
- **Small empty windows no longer flash on the screen while the program starts.** A waypoint row's "players" field was shown before it had a parent window, so every saved waypoint produced a stray window for a moment. Only the overlay and the tray icon appear at start-up now.

### Update
Installed users: tray icon → "Check for updates". Others: download `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` or `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`. Settings, points and players are kept.
